rows.question: How long does Kestrel Standard delivery take?
rows.answer: Kestrel Standard is the default service for domestic parcels. [1] Delivery takes 2 to 4 business days after the first depot scan. [1]

rows.question: What is the latest time I can hand over an Express parcel for next-day delivery?
rows.answer: Kestrel Express delivers on the next business day before 18:00, provided the parcel is handed over before the 16:00 cut-off. [1] Parcels handed over after the cut-off travel the following day. [1]

rows.question: Which is the cheapest shipping option and how slow is it?
rows.answer: Saturday delivery is an option on Express only. [1]

rows.question: How much is the Saturday delivery surcharge?
rows.answer: Saturday delivery is an option on Express only. [1] It costs a surcharge of 4.50 EUR per parcel and must be selected when the label is created. [1]

rows.question: My overnight parcel showed up two days late. Do I get my money back?
rows.answer: A parcel stopped by customs for missing paperwork gets status code CU-301 (missing invoice). [1] The sender has 14 days to supply the documents through the portal. [1]

rows.question: What is the maximum weight of a single parcel?
rows.answer: A single parcel may weigh at most 31.5 kg. [1] Parcels above these limits are refused at pickup or returned from the depot. [1]

rows.question: How do you bill a big box that weighs almost nothing?
rows.answer: Use a rigid cardboard box in good condition. [1] Parcels heavier than 15 kg need a double-wall box. [1]

rows.question: What kind of box do I need for a parcel over 15 kg?
rows.answer: Use a rigid cardboard box in good condition. [1] Parcels heavier than 15 kg need a double-wall box. [1]

rows.question: I'm sending a poster tube that can't go on the conveyor. Is there an extra charge?
rows.answer: A parcel that is inside the limits but cannot travel on the sorting belt, for example a tube or an irregular shape, is handled by hand. [1]

rows.question: Can I ship a power bank with Express?
rows.answer: Lithium batteries are accepted only when they are installed in the device they power, and only up to 100 Wh per battery. [1] Loose batteries and power banks are not accepted on Express, because Express parcels may travel by air. [1]

rows.question: What is the largest battery capacity allowed inside a laptop I ship?
rows.answer: Lithium batteries are accepted only when they are installed in the device they power, and only up to 100 Wh per battery. [1] Loose batteries and power banks are not accepted on Express, because Express parcels may travel by air. [1]

rows.question: Does Kestrel carry live animals?
rows.answer: Kestrel does not carry cash, bank cards, aerosols, fireworks, perishable food outside the Cool service, or live animals. [1]

rows.question: Can I mail a potted fern abroad?
rows.answer: I could not find this in the documents.

rows.question: What is the fee when undeclared restricted goods are found?
rows.answer: When a parcel is found to contain undeclared restricted goods, it is returned to the sender and a return fee of 15 EUR is charged. [1]

rows.question: Until what time can I book a pickup for the same day?
rows.answer: A pickup can be booked in the portal or through the API. [1] Bookings made before 12:00 are collected the same day. [1]

rows.question: What are the time slots for a driver to come and collect?
rows.answer: Drivers cannot commit to an exact time inside a window. [1]

rows.question: How many parcels a week do I need to send to get a fixed collection schedule?
rows.answer: An account that ships at least 10 parcels per week can ask for a recurring pickup on fixed days. [1]

rows.question: How long does the driver wait at a pickup?
rows.answer: The driver waits up to 5 minutes at the collection point. [1]

rows.question: What does PU-204 mean?
rows.answer: PU-204 means the premises were closed at pickup. [1] DP-220 means the parcel arrived at a depot. [1]

rows.question: How many delivery attempts does Kestrel make?
rows.answer: Kestrel makes up to 3 delivery attempts, on consecutive business days. [1] After each failed attempt the recipient receives a notification with a link to choose another day or a parcel shop. [1]

rows.question: Nobody was home three times. Where is my package now and for how long?
rows.answer: If nobody is available, the stop is recorded with status code PU-204 (premises closed). [1]

rows.question: Can the courier just drop the box behind my garden gate?
rows.answer: Depots accept drop-offs from 07:00 to 20:00 on business days. [1] Later drop-offs leave the next evening. [1]

rows.question: When is a signature required?
rows.answer: A signature is required for every parcel with a declared value above 500 EUR, and whenever the sender selects the signature option. [1] The signature is captured on the driver's handheld and stored as proof of delivery. [1]

rows.question: What does NO-NBR on a label mean?
rows.answer: Senders who do not want this print the code NO-NBR on the label by ticking "No neighbour delivery" at label creation. [1]

rows.question: How much does an address correction cost after dispatch?
rows.answer: Once the parcel has been scanned, an address correction costs 3.90 EUR. [1] If the parcel is already on the delivery vehicle, the correction applies to the next attempt. [1]

rows.question: I typed the wrong street but the parcel hasn't been scanned yet. Will fixing it cost me?
rows.answer: Once the parcel has been scanned, an address correction costs 3.90 EUR. [1] If the parcel is already on the delivery vehicle, the correction applies to the next attempt. [1]

rows.question: Can I send a parcel that's already travelling to a different country instead?
rows.answer: A parcel cannot be redirected to another country, and the service level cannot be changed after collection. [1] For those cases the parcel has to be returned to the sender and shipped again. [1]

rows.question: A parcel shows AD-110. What happens to it?
rows.answer: When the sorting system cannot resolve an address, the parcel gets status code AD-110 (address incomplete) and is held at the depot for 5 business days. [1]

rows.question: How many days do I have to report a damaged parcel?
rows.answer: Damage must be reported within 7 calendar days of delivery. [1] The claim form asks for four photos: the outer box, the shipping label, the inner packaging and the damaged item. [1]

rows.question: Which pictures do I need to send when a shipment arrives broken?
rows.answer: POST /shipments creates a shipment and returns the tracking number and the label. [1] A shipment can be cancelled with DELETE /shipments/{id} until its first scan. [1]

rows.question: After how long without tracking updates is a package declared missing?
rows.answer: A parcel stopped by customs for missing paperwork gets status code CU-301 (missing invoice). [1] After that the parcel is returned at the sender's cost. [1]

rows.question: What is the maximum compensation per parcel?
rows.answer: Under standard liability, compensation is 25 EUR per kilogram of actual weight, up to 500 EUR per parcel. [1] Shipping fees are refunded when the parcel is lost. [1]

rows.question: How quickly will I hear back about my claim?
rows.answer: Claims are decided within 10 business days after all documents have been received. [1] A claim that is refused comes with the reason, and the customer has 30 days to ask for a second review. [1]

rows.question: How long is a return label valid?
rows.answer: A return label is created in the portal under Shipments, Create return. [1] The label is valid for 30 days. [1]

rows.question: What do you charge when a customer sends an item back?
rows.answer: When a parcel is found to contain undeclared restricted goods, it is returned to the sender and a return fee of 15 EUR is charged. [1]

rows.question: On which weekday do consolidated returns arrive?
rows.answer: Accounts with the Return Hub option do not receive returns one by one. [1] Returns are collected at the hub and delivered together once a week, on Thursday. [1]

rows.question: The recipient turned the parcel away at the door. What rate applies for sending it back?
rows.answer: A parcel that the recipient refuses at the door is returned to the sender automatically. [1] The return leg is billed at the Standard rate, not at the reduced return rate. [1]

rows.question: How many copies of the commercial invoice are needed?
rows.answer: Every parcel that leaves the customs union needs a commercial invoice in 3 copies, attached to the outside of the parcel in a document pouch. [1] The invoice must state the value, the currency and a clear description of each item. [1]

rows.question: When is an HS code required?
rows.answer: A Harmonized System (HS) code is required for each item when the goods are worth more than 150 EUR in total. [1]

rows.question: What is the handling fee if we pay import taxes for the receiver?
rows.answer: By default parcels travel DAP (delivered at place): the recipient pays duties and taxes on arrival. [1] Kestrel then pays on the sender's behalf and invoices the amount with a handling fee of 6 EUR per parcel. [1]

rows.question: What should I do about status CU-301?
rows.answer: A parcel stopped by customs for missing paperwork gets status code CU-301 (missing invoice). [1]

rows.question: What does a Kestrel tracking number look like?
rows.answer: A Kestrel tracking number starts with the letters KS, followed by 10 digits and a two-letter country code, for example KS0048213377DE. [1] Tracking events are kept for 180 days after delivery. [1]

rows.question: What is DP-235?
rows.answer: DP-220 means the parcel arrived at a depot. [1] DP-235 means a sorting delay: the parcel missed its planned linehaul and will leave on the next one. [1]

rows.question: Meaning of EX-512?
rows.answer: EX-500 means the parcel was damaged in transit and is being inspected. [1] EX-512 means the label was unreadable and the parcel was relabelled at the depot, which usually adds one day. [1]

rows.question: What does DL-417 stand for?
rows.answer: DL-400 means delivered. [1] DL-417 means the recipient was absent and a new attempt is planned. [1]

rows.question: When are invoices issued?
rows.answer: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month and cover all parcels scanned during the previous month. [1] Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date, by bank transfer or by card. [1]

rows.question: How many days do we have to pay a bill?
rows.answer: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month and cover all parcels scanned during the previous month. [1] Payment is due within 14 days of the invoice date, by bank transfer or by card. [1]

rows.question: When is next month's fuel percentage announced?
rows.answer: A fuel surcharge is applied as a percentage of the transport price. [1] The percentage is revised every month and published in the portal on the 25th for the following month. [1]

rows.question: How long do I have to dispute an invoice?
rows.answer: A billing dispute must be opened within 30 days of the invoice date, from the invoice page in the portal or by writing to billing@kestrel-parcel.example. [1] Lines that are not disputed remain due on the normal date. [1]

rows.question: Can I get my bill on paper and what does it cost?
rows.answer: A paper copy by post can be requested and costs 2 EUR per invoice. [1]

rows.question: What is the API rate limit?
rows.answer: Each API key may send 120 requests per minute. [1] Above that the API answers with HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header that gives the number of seconds to wait. [1]

rows.question: Which header carries the API key?
rows.answer: The REST API is served at https://api.kestrel-parcel.example/v2. [1] Each request carries an API key in the X-Kestrel-Key header. [1]

rows.question: How do I avoid creating a duplicate shipment when my request is retried after a timeout?
rows.answer: If it does not, the event is retried 6 times with exponential backoff, spread over 24 hours. [1]

rows.question: Is there a test environment and when is its data cleared?
rows.answer: A person can ask for a copy of their data or for its deletion. [1] They are handled by the data protection officer, at privacy@kestrel-parcel.example. [1]

rows.question: How many shipments can the batch endpoint take?
rows.answer: Bulk label creation should use the batch endpoint, which accepts up to 100 shipments in one request. [1]

rows.question: How many times is a webhook retried?
rows.answer: If it does not, the event is retried 6 times with exponential backoff, spread over 24 hours. [1]

rows.question: What is in the X-Kestrel-Signature header?
rows.answer: The X-Kestrel-Signature header contains an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body, computed with the webhook secret. [1] Reject any request whose signature does not match. [1]

rows.question: How much empty space is needed around the barcode?
rows.answer: The main barcode is a Code 128 symbol. [1] Do not fold the label over an edge of the box and do not cover the barcode with glossy tape, which reflects the scanner light. [1]

rows.question: How many times can a label be reprinted for free?
rows.answer: A label can be reprinted from the portal up to 5 times at no cost. [1] Reprints keep the same tracking number. [1]

rows.question: I printed a label three weeks ago. Can I still use it?

rows.answer: A ticket that tier 1 has not solved after 1 business day goes to tier 2. [1] If tier 2 cannot solve it within 2 more business days, the duty manager takes ownership and calls the customer. [1]

rows.question: Until what time can I bring parcels to the depot so they leave tonight?
rows.answer: Depots accept drop-offs from 07:00 to 20:00 on business days. [1] Parcels dropped off before 18:30 leave on the same evening's linehaul. [1]

rows.question: When do I need a manifest for a drop-off?
rows.answer: A drop-off of more than 50 parcels needs a manifest, uploaded in the portal at least 2 hours before arrival. [1] Without a manifest the parcels are accepted but processed the next day. [1]

rows.question: What is the maximum pallet height?
rows.answer: Pallets may be up to 1.8 m high and weigh up to 800 kg. [1] Parcels on a pallet must each carry their own label, facing outwards. [1]

rows.question: What temperature does Kestrel Cool maintain?
rows.answer: Kestrel Cool keeps parcels between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius. [1] The maximum transit time is 48 hours, and a Cool parcel may weigh at most 20 kg. [1]

rows.question: Why can't I book a chilled shipment on a Friday?
rows.answer: There is no Friday collection, so that no parcel stays in the network over a weekend. [1]

rows.question: How long should the ice packs be in the freezer beforehand?
rows.answer: Gel packs must be frozen for at least 24 hours before packing and placed above and below the goods. [1] Do not use dry ice. [1]

rows.question: How much is the Cool surcharge?

rows.question: How long is recipient data kept?
